content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge text resolves a link collision by separating the challenger’s wording answer from the defender’s application answer rather than weighing the chains by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the virgin and young-woman wording in [DR3] and defender answered the prophetic application in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "‘weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse’ — whether the split between wording and prophetic application is a chain-footing comparison or a piecemeal verse-level treatment; I read the text as the latter.", "why": "It declares the link underdetermined by noting one side answered the wording and the other the application, which separates the verse’s aspects instead of weighing the pressed chain against the link chain by footing as K-C requires."}
